blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment on Wednesday, September 23, voted to lower the number of votes needed to convict Vice President Sara Duterte. This development came after the majority of the senator-judges voted to reduce the Senate impeachment conviction threshold after both the defense and prosecution’s oral arguments on the matter. If she ever does get convicted, Duterte faces possible removal from office and perpetual disqualification from holding any public office.
